interpolation.method: Supplied elevations (contour vertices and control points) are held fixed. A vertex created where two constraints intersect keeps the elevation from the contour it lies on and is filled by linear interpolation in arc length along that contour between the nearest supplied vertices. Every remaining unknown vertex is the solution of a discrete harmonic (Laplace) problem over the triangulated surface: its value is the average of its TIN neighbours, with all supplied elevations fixed. The system is solved by successive over-relaxation to a residual of 7.50e-03 elevation units.
